system.description:
A target may only benefit from one invocation of the restoration boon to remove fatigue within a 24 hour period.

Applied automatically when a Restoration reduces the Fatigued bane; while present, further Restorations leave Fatigued untouched. There is no automated timer — remove this effect manually once the 24 hours have passed.

effects.name: Restoration Fatigue Immunity
effects.description: This character already benefited from a Restoration boon against Fatigued. They may not benefit from another for 24 hours. Remove this effect manually once the 24 hours have passed.
